engine.name: Godot Engine
engine.note: Paths are relative to the Godot checkout (godot/). lineHash is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the cited line with surrounding whitespace removed.

gating.inspect: SSR runs when the Environment enables it and the viewport's background is not transparent; a reflection probe's render never computes it.
gating.inspectZh: 当 Environment 启用 SSR 且视口背景不透明时运行 SSR；反射探针的渲染从不计算它。

ssr-normal-roughness.inspect: Using SSR makes the depth pre-pass write the normal-roughness buffer too (PASS_MODE_DEPTH_NORMAL_ROUGHNESS).
ssr-normal-roughness.inspectZh: 启用 SSR 会让深度预渲染同时写入法线-粗糙度缓冲（PASS_MODE_DEPTH_NORMAL_ROUGHNESS）。

process-ssr.inspect: Before the opaque pass: allocate the SSR buffers, build each view's reprojection matrix, keep this frame's camera for the next, and run the SSR passes.
process-ssr.inspectZh: 在不透明渲染之前：分配 SSR 缓冲，为每个视图构建重投影矩阵，保存本帧相机供下一帧使用，并运行 SSR 各渲染阶段。

reprojection.inspect: The reprojection: this frame's screen to view space (inverse projection), to the world (camera transform), to last frame's view (its inverse transform), to last frame's screen (its projection). Camera only: no motion vectors.
reprojection.inspectZh: 重投影：从本帧屏幕到视图空间（逆投影），到世界（相机变换），到上一帧视图（其逆变换），再到上一帧屏幕（其投影）。只考虑相机：不读取运动矢量。

copy-last-frame.inspect: After the transparent pass and the MSAA resolve, the internal HDR colour is copied into the last-frame texture that the next frame's trace reads.
copy-last-frame.inspectZh: 在透明渲染和 MSAA 解析之后，内部 HDR 颜色被复制到上一帧纹理，供下一帧的追踪读取。

resolve-flag.inspect: The flag named RESOLVE_SSR is set at full size, when no resolve pass ran: the opaque pass then picks the blur level and undoes the compression itself.
resolve-flag.inspectZh: 名为 RESOLVE_SSR 的标志在全尺寸（没有运行 resolve 阶段）时被设置：此时不透明渲染自己选择模糊级别并撤销压缩。

env-defaults.inspect: The Environment's SSR settings and defaults: off, 64 steps, fade in 0.15, fade out 2.0, depth tolerance 0.5.
env-defaults.inspectZh: Environment 的 SSR 设置及默认值：关闭，64 步，淡入 0.15，淡出 2.0，深度容差 0.5。

details.note: The depth tolerance, in view-space units.
details.noteZh: 深度容差，单位为视图空间单位。

half-size-setting.inspect: The project setting that runs SSR at half resolution, on by default.
half-size-setting.inspectZh: 让 SSR 以半分辨率运行的项目设置，默认开启。

ssr-size.inspect: The SSR buffers are half the internal size (rounded down) at half size.
ssr-size.inspectZh: 半尺寸时，SSR 缓冲是内部尺寸的一半（向下取整）。

mip-count.inspect: The mip count: both sides halved while both are above one texel.
mip-count.inspectZh: mip 数量：两边都大于一个纹素时，两边各减半。

hiz-texture.inspect: The depth pyramid: R32_SFLOAT at the SSR size, with the full mip chain.
hiz-texture.inspectZh: 深度金字塔：R32_SFLOAT，SSR 尺寸，带完整 mip 链。

mip-level-texture.inspect: The blur level per pixel: R8_UNORM, storing the level divided by 14.
mip-level-texture.inspectZh: 每个像素的模糊级别：R8_UNORM，存储级别除以 14。

last-frame-size.inspect: With SSR at half size and SSIL off, the last frame is kept at half size.
last-frame-size.inspectZh: SSR 为半尺寸且 SSIL 关闭时，上一帧以半尺寸保存。

pass-downsample.inspect: The half-size downsample of depth and normal-roughness (half size only), choosing a variant when the full size is odd.
pass-downsample.inspectZh: 深度和法线-粗糙度的半尺寸下采样（仅半尺寸），全尺寸为奇数时选择变体。

downsample-winner.inspect: Of the four (or six, or nine) full-size depths, the largest wins: with reversed Z that is the nearest surface.
downsample-winner.inspectZh: 在四个（或六个、九个）全尺寸深度中取最大者：在反向 Z 下即最近的表面。

downsample-normal.inspect: The half-size normal-roughness is the winner's texel, copied unchanged.
downsample-normal.inspectZh: 半尺寸的法线-粗糙度是胜出者的纹素，原样复制。

pass-hiz.inspect: The pyramid's levels 1 and up, one dispatch per level, each choosing an odd variant from its parent's size.
pass-hiz.inspectZh: 金字塔的第 1 级及以上，每级一次调度，各自根据上一级的尺寸选择奇数变体。

hiz-max.inspect: Each texel of a level is the max of its 2 x 2 parents: the nearest depth anywhere under it.
hiz-max.inspectZh: 每级的每个纹素是其 2 x 2 上级纹素的最大值：其下方任何位置的最近深度。

pass-main.inspect: The trace, one thread per SSR pixel, with the Environment's steps, fades, and tolerance as push constants.
pass-main.inspectZh: 追踪，每个 SSR 像素一个线程，Environment 的步数、淡化和容差作为推送常量。

trace-sky.inspect: A pixel of depth 0 (the far plane: sky) is not traced.
trace-sky.inspectZh: 深度为 0 的像素（远平面：天空）不追踪。

trace-rough.inspect: Roughness 0.7 or more is not traced, for speed; it writes zero colour and level.
trace-rough.inspectZh: 粗糙度 0.7 及以上不追踪，以节省时间；写入零颜色和零级别。

geom-normal.inspect: The surface's true normal rebuilt from the pyramid's level 0: on each axis, the side whose two depths extrapolate best to the centre.
geom-normal.inspectZh: 从金字塔第 0 级重建表面的真实法线：在每个轴上，取两个深度外推到中心最准的一侧。

bias.inspect: The start is pushed off the surface along the geometric normal, by one minus the eighth power of how far the shading normal agrees.
bias.inspectZh: 起点沿几何法线推离表面，距离为一减去着色法线与之一致程度的八次方。

bounce.inspect: A reflected ray pointing into the true surface is reflected again about the geometric normal.
bounce.inspectZh: 指向真实表面内部的反射射线，会再关于几何法线反射一次。

camera-clip.inspect: The comment says the near plane; the end point is clipped to the camera's plane, z = -0.00001.
camera-clip.inspectZh: 注释说的是近平面；终点实际被裁剪到相机平面 z = -0.00001。

parametric-t.inspect: The screen-space ray is scaled so its depth changes by exactly one per unit of t (Supnik's parametric t).
parametric-t.inspectZh: 屏幕空间射线被缩放，使 t 每变化一个单位深度正好变化一（Supnik 的参数化 t）。

t-max.inspect: Where the ray leaves the screen: the trace stops there.
t-max.inspectZh: 射线离开屏幕之处：追踪在此停止。

start-advance.inspect: The start is advanced out of the pixel's own cell, so the ray never hits itself.
start-advance.inspectZh: 起点被推出像素自身的单元格，因此射线不会击中自己。

loop.inspect: The loop runs while the level is not below zero, steps remain, and the ray is on screen.
loop.inspectZh: 当级别不低于零、仍有步数、射线仍在屏幕内时，循环继续。

hit-test.inspect: A cell may hold a hit when the ray reaches the cell's nearest depth before leaving it (or, toward the camera, is already behind it).
hit-test.inspectZh: 当射线在离开单元格前到达其最近深度（朝向相机时则是已在其后方）时，该单元格可能包含命中。

tolerance.inspect: At level 0 only: a ray more than the tolerance behind the surface passes under it, staying at level 0.
tolerance.inspectZh: 仅在第 0 级：位于表面后方超过容差的射线从其下方穿过，停留在第 0 级。

level-step.inspect: A miss climbs one level (cells twice as wide), a hit descends one.
level-step.inspectZh: 未命中则上升一级（单元格宽一倍），命中则下降一级。

validity.inspect: Validity, not a yes or no: it goes into alpha, so invalid pixels still write a blur level.
validity.inspectZh: 用有效度代替是或否：它写入 alpha，因此无效像素仍会写入模糊级别。

edge-sky.inspect: A ray that left the screen, or ended on the sky, is invalid.
edge-sky.inspectZh: 离开屏幕或终止于天空的射线无效。

backface.inspect: The back-face test runs only when the hit is within two SSR pixels of the start on both axes.
backface.inspectZh: 背面测试只在命中点在两个轴上都距起点两个 SSR 像素以内时运行。

confidence.inspect: Confidence falls with the distance between the ray's end and the surface under it, squared.
confidence.inspectZh: 置信度随射线终点与其下方表面之间的距离下降，并取平方。

margin.inspect: A fade near the last frame's edges, on the product of the two edge distances.
margin.inspectZh: 在上一帧边缘附近淡出，基于两个边缘距离的乘积。

fades.inspect: Fade in and fade out over the ray's screen length: together they peak at 0.58 with the defaults.
fades.inspectZh: 随射线屏幕长度淡入和淡出：默认值下二者乘积的峰值为 0.58。

details.note: The fade in, ray length to the power fade_in.
details.noteZh: 淡入：射线长度的 fade_in 次方。

last-frame-color.inspect: The colour is last frame's, at the reprojected point, premultiplied by validity.
last-frame-color.inspectZh: 颜色取自上一帧的重投影点，并预乘有效度。

compress.inspect: The colour is compressed by its luminance before filtering, so bright texels do not dominate.
compress.inspectZh: 颜色在滤波前按亮度压缩，使明亮的纹素不会占主导。

cone.inspect: Roughness becomes a cone's half-angle: roughness times ninety degrees.
cone.inspectZh: 粗糙度变为圆锥半角：粗糙度乘以九十度。

blur-radius.inspect: The radius of the circle inside the cone where the ray ends.
blur-radius.inspectZh: 射线终点处圆锥内切圆的半径。

mip-bias.inspect: The circle's radius in pixels becomes a mip level: log2 of radius over 16, plus one, clamped to the mips (and later lowered for long rays).
mip-bias.inspectZh: 以像素计的圆半径变为 mip 级别：半径除以 16 加一后取 log2，限制在 mip 范围内（之后对长射线再降低）。

mip-store.inspect: The level is stored divided by 14 in eight bits.
mip-store.inspectZh: 级别除以 14 后以八位存储。

pass-filter.inspect: The roughness filter, one dispatch per level, each from the level before.
pass-filter.inspectZh: 粗糙度滤波，每级一次调度，各自基于上一级。

filter-weights.inspect: Seven Gaussian weights, summing to one.
filter-weights.inspectZh: 七个高斯权重，总和为一。

filter-weight.inspect: An invalid texel weighs min(0.2 x level, 1) of a valid one's weight, blended by alpha.
filter-weight.inspectZh: 无效纹素的权重是有效纹素的 min(0.2 x 级别, 1)，按 alpha 混合。

filter-sample.inspect: Each fetch lands on the corner of four parent texels: a 2 x 2 average.
filter-sample.inspectZh: 每次取样都落在四个上级纹素的角上：即 2 x 2 平均。

pass-resolve.inspect: The resolve to the internal size (half size only).
pass-resolve.inspectZh: 解析到内部尺寸（仅半尺寸）。

resolve-taps.inspect: Four half-size taps around the full-size pixel, each at its own blur level.
resolve-taps.inspectZh: 全尺寸像素周围的四个半尺寸取样点，各自使用自己的模糊级别。

resolve-weights.inspect: Each tap is weighted by depth (2048), normal (32), and roughness (16) similarity.
resolve-weights.inspectZh: 每个取样点按深度（2048）、法线（32）和粗糙度（16）的相似度加权。

resolve-uncompress.inspect: The compression is undone per tap, before the taps are averaged.
resolve-uncompress.inspectZh: 在平均各取样点之前，逐个撤销压缩。

nr-write.inspect: The pre-pass writes the encoded view-space normal and the roughness.
nr-write.inspectZh: 预渲染写入编码后的视图空间法线和粗糙度。

details.note: Roughness takes seven bits; above one half means a dynamic object.
details.noteZh: 粗糙度占七位；大于一半表示动态物体。

encode24.inspect: Best-fit normals: the normal scaled to touch the unit cube, then to the length that quantizes best (Kaplanyan, SIGGRAPH 2010).
encode24.inspectZh: 最佳拟合法线：将法线缩放到接触单位立方体，再缩放到量化误差最小的长度（Kaplanyan，SIGGRAPH 2010）。

best-fit-table.inspect: The table, made once at start-up: for each direction of a 1024 x 1024 folded-cube grid, the length whose 8-bit quantization errs least.
best-fit-table.inspectZh: 启动时生成一次的表：对 1024 x 1024 折叠立方体网格的每个方向，取 8 位量化误差最小的长度。

limiter.inspect: The roughness limiter widens roughness where the normal changes across the pixel.
limiter.inspectZh: 粗糙度限制器在法线跨像素变化处增大粗糙度。

sky-reflection.inspect: The sky's reflection along a direction bent toward the normal by roughness squared, faded below the horizon.
sky-reflection.inspectZh: 沿按粗糙度平方偏向法线的方向取天空反射，在地平线以下淡出。

spec-occlusion.inspect: Specular occlusion from the ambient light's luminance dims the reflection before SSR is blended in.
spec-occlusion.inspectZh: 由环境光亮度得出的镜面遮蔽，在混入 SSR 之前使反射变暗。

ssr-fade.inspect: Between roughness 0.6 and 0.7 the SSR result fades out, smoothing the trace's cut-off.
ssr-fade.inspectZh: 在粗糙度 0.6 到 0.7 之间 SSR 结果淡出，使追踪的截断变得平滑。

ssr-blend.inspect: SSR covers the indirect specular by its validity (alpha is premultiplied).
ssr-blend.inspectZh: SSR 按其有效度覆盖间接镜面光（alpha 已预乘）。

reflection-source.inspect: The sky's reflection is used only when the reflection source is the sky, or the background and the background is the sky; Disabled leaves none for SSR to cover.
reflection-source.inspectZh: 只有当反射来源是天空，或是背景且背景为天空时，才使用天空反射；Disabled 时 SSR 没有可覆盖的反射。

f0.inspect: f0: 0.16 times specular squared for a dielectric (0.04 at the default 0.5), the albedo for a metal, mixed by metallic.
f0.inspectZh: f0：电介质为 0.16 乘 specular 的平方（默认 0.5 时为 0.04），金属为反照率，按 metallic 混合。

env-brdf.inspect: After the blend, the environment BRDF scales it: SSR is treated as incoming light, like a probe.
env-brdf.inspectZh: 混合之后，环境 BRDF 对其缩放：SSR 被视为入射光，与探针相同。

chapters.title: Depth, normals, and one thread per pixel
chapters.titleZh: 深度、法线与每像素一个线程

chapters.title: Is it a hit, and what colour
chapters.titleZh: 是否命中，以及什么颜色

mappings.exact: R8G8B8A8_UNORM: rgb the view-space normal through encode24, times 0.5 plus 0.5; a the roughness times 127/255, one minus that for a dynamic instance.
mappings.exactZh: R8G8B8A8_UNORM：rgb 为经 encode24 编码的视图空间法线乘 0.5 加 0.5；a 为粗糙度乘 127/255，动态实例则为一减去它。
mappings.labLayout: The same texel, written by ssrPrepassFS into a multisampled Rgba8Unorm target; the lab's objects are static.
mappings.labLayoutZh: 相同的纹素，由 ssrPrepassFS 写入多重采样的 Rgba8Unorm 目标；实验室中的物体都是静态的。

mappings.exact: R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT at the SSR size with the full mip chain: rgb last frame's colour times validity, divided by one plus its Rec. 709 luminance; a the validity.
mappings.exactZh: R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT，SSR 尺寸，带完整 mip 链：rgb 为上一帧颜色乘有效度，再除以一加其 Rec. 709 亮度；a 为有效度。
mappings.labLayout: The same, the program image ssrColor.
